articles.title: Budget Xiaomi smartwatch receives surprise release in new countries with 21 days battery life
articles.description: Xiaomi has given one of its latest budget smartwatches a broader release in even more countries. Now available in countries like Germany and the UK, the Smart Band 11 retails for just €59.99 and £54.99 despite boasting up to 21 days of battery life and a 2,000-nit AMOLED display.

articles.title: Oppo launches affordable 12.1-inch tablet with 2.8K 120Hz display and 10,050mAh battery
articles.description: Oppo has launched the Pad Air6, a 12.1-inch tablet with a 2.8K 120Hz display, a Dimensity 7360 Super processor and a 10,050mAh battery. It also offers an optional anti-glare display and updated AI-powered learning features.
